name: TheBrain Import
changes: Does not count or write a note body with only white space.
Releases the selected export when the dialog closes during the file read.
tip: You can import without a .brz archive. Select thoughts.json and links.json together in the file picker.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. TheBrain Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
